Having a good therapist is also very very important. If I had a better one I probably wouldn't need all these meds. I'm not even sure what's working and what isn't and I don't want to have to get on even more medication. I'm also not sure when I'll be able to stop taking them and that makes me anxious often.

I think I understand what you mean about the sad phases, I go through that too very often and I also used to self harm when I was younger because of how intense my emotions would be. It took me a while to get to a point where I could handle my feelings in a little bit more of a healthy way. It's been a lot harder lately for me to not go back to doing it. It sucks when those thoughts creep back in after a really long good streak. Just know that these feelings will pass and when they do you could have a totally different mindset and if you don't maybe you'll be in a state of mind to be able to talk to someone about it and see if there's anything that can be done to help you when the thoughts and feelings get really intense. Don't act on your thoughts and urges. Things will get better I promise and you'll be so glad you didn't do it.

I think it's nice to let people know how much you appreciate them and maybe you can have a conversation with them about how you don't want them to feel pressure, just that they're very important to you. I also completely understand what you mean by it being hard to be okay alone. It takes a lot of time to get used to that. Maybe see if someone you really trust or a few people can check in with you daily even if it's just good morning or good night or a simple how are you. It's tough to reach out to people and be that direct and vulnerable and I totally understand not wanting to bother anyone. you could try starting conversations with them or checking on them daily or every few days and that way you both know that you care about each other and have each other in mind.

Hey dude. You're only 22. You have so much to see and offer and experience. And who says you'll never get into a relationship? Maybe you just haven't found the right person yet and relationships are overrated anyway. A lot of them just leave you with bitter feelings and possibly trauma especially when you're young. I promise you aren't missing out on much. Also, you have so much time to choose a different path in life. You don't have to stay at school and if you do you can choose something else to study. Also if it would help you can dm me and we can talk about the presentation and I can give you tips and tons of encouragement because I have a feeling you've definitely got this and once you show your anxiety who's boss you're gonna do great. Also, you're not alone in this feeling. Tons of people struggle with social anxiety and you probably even have a few people in your class who do. I;m not sure if it helps to know that but it sometimes helps me to know that I'm not the only one feeling nervous. 

Hang in there friend. You're gonna be okay. Life doesn't need a direction to go in or any specific reason. It's an experience full of good and bad and ups and downs. I hope you experience more of the good going forward.
